protocol.acceptance: Each symbol center must meet max_relative_error; envelope sensitivity reported separately and cannot convert a failed center criterion to pass
protocol.calibration: none; no parameter fitting or point exclusion based on model residuals
protocol.criterion_semantics: Engineering screening tolerance fixed before model evaluation; not measurement uncertainty or NIST acceptance criterion
protocol.digitization_semantics: Vector symbol bounding-box midpoint; full half-symbol extent plus 0.01 form coordinate unit as conservative coordinate-reading bounds, not probabilistic confidence intervals
protocol.scope: Steady single-phase straight copper pipe; all four plotted repeat series. No plant, transient, two-phase, thermal or neutron validation
protocol.status_policy: Experimental comparison only; validated=false and plant_referenced=false regardless of screening outcome
protocol.uncertainty_semantics: No complete per-point experimental uncertainty budget available in the figure; do not infer it from the plotted Colebrook +/-3 percent comparison band

reading_bounds: symbol extents; not measurement confidence intervals
scope: Component Darcy coefficient only; turbulent NIST points; no laminar, network, transient or two-phase validation

uncertainty_review.mass_flow: each meter: 0.05% reading above 0.264 kg/s; otherwise 0.95 kg/h
missing: per-point flow, density, temperature and length records
uncertainty_review.pressure_example: p.22: mean standard uncertainty 0.4%, other conditions within 0.5%; not assigned to each figure-18 point
